content: Department of Biochemistry is led by Dr. Sidra Pervez (Incharge/Chairperson). Email: biochemistry@sbbwu.edu.pk, Tel: +92-91-9224813.

Biochemistry faculty includes Dr. Rehana Masood (Assistant Professor), Ms. Sarah Sarwar (Lecturer), Dr. Rifat Jahan (Lecturer), Ms. Kiran Zafar (Lecturer), Dr. Sidra Pervez (Assistant Professor), Ms. Haleema Hidayat (Lecturer), Dr. Bushra Ahmad (Assistant Professor), Kiran Saba (Lecturer).

Biochemistry program focuses on molecular processes in living systems and develops skills in critical thinking, research, problem solving, and prepares students for careers in medicine, pharmacy, and industry.
Biochemistry Vision: To become a leading department in KPK by providing quality education, research, and practical skills in pharmaceutical and medical sciences.
Biochemistry Mission: To provide quality education through innovative teaching, research ethics, problem-solving skills, and community service while producing competent professionals.
Biochemistry offers BS and MS/MPhil programs.
Department of Bioinformatics is led by Dr. Farhat Amin (Chairperson). Email: bioinformatics@sbbwu.edu.pk, Tel: +92-91-9224790.

Bioinformatics integrates biology, computing, and medicine for analyzing biomedical data and solving interdisciplinary problems.
Bioinformatics program started in 2007 to meet the need for experts in biology, computing, and biomedical data analysis.
Bioinformatics offers BS 4-year program with focus on interdisciplinary research and biomedical applications.
Biotechnology department is focused on improving human life through pharmaceuticals, agriculture, bioenergy, and environmental applications.
Biotechnology mission is to produce graduates with theoretical and practical expertise to become researchers, educators, and entrepreneurs.
Biotechnology vision is to empower individuals to use biotechnology for improving quality of life and informed decision-making.
Department of Botany is led by Dr. Faiza Tawab (Chairperson). Email: botany@sbbwu.edu.pk, Tel: 9224811.
Botany faculty includes Dr. Faiza Tawab, Dr. Naila Inayat, Dr. Ambrin, Dr. Rimsha Zainab as Assistant Professors.
Botany studies plant science including genetics, ecology, physiology, microbiology, and plant pathology for environmental and food security.
Botany mission is to train students in plant sciences, research diseases, improve food production, and preserve biodiversity.

The Department of English Language & Literature is led by Ms. Sadia Nazeer (Incharge/Chairperson). Contact details include Email: english@sbbwu.edu.pk and Telephone: +92-91-9224725.

The department focuses on English language and literature studies, rhetoric, narrative skills, analytical skills, research, literary approaches, and theoretical issues. Its vision is to become a leading department that promotes research and scholarly activities in literature and linguistics.

The mission of the department is to inspire appreciation of English language and literature, encourage creative expression, and provide an in-depth understanding of literature through study and research.
Programs offered include BS, MA, M.Phil in English Literature, Masters in English Language & Literature, and Certificate Courses in English Language.
Faculty includes Ms. Hoor Shamail Khattak, Ms. Sadia Nazeer, Ms. Henna Karamat, Ms. Beenish Asmatullah, Dr. Anbarin Fatima, Ms. Shumaila Ashee, and Ms. Sehrish.
